svg.title: Four words for unpredictability in security risk work
svg.desc: Four panels. Random: a fair die and two histograms, one uniform and one not, both random. Stochastic: hits scattered around a target with a bell-shaped spread. Aleatoric: uncertainty falls with more data until it reaches a floor that more data cannot remove. Intermittent: two on and off signals over time, one regular and one irregular.
svg.text: Four words for unpredictability in security risk work

g.text: Any distribution; uniform is one case
A random process with a model
Noise that more data cannot remove
The schedule can be regular or not
